meta.title: A line item marked Regret cannot be awarded
gaps: it depends on a company setting this run does not change — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “One or more selected line items cannot be awarded as they have been marked as Regret”, and never with a server error.
